name: Ororon
description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind. He seems to have a special connection with the Night Kingdom, and his motives are difficult to discern.

skillTalents.name: Night-Wind's Spirit
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.
Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG. While aiming, the power of Electro will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged arrow will deal Electro DMG.
Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Misty Night's Bindings
skillTalents.description:
Ororon leaps up and throws a Spirit Orb that bounces between opponents, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG.
Nightsoul's Blessing: Ororon
When the Spirit Orb hits an opponent, Ororon enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gains 40 Nightsoul points. This state lasts 6s. If the Nightsoul points are exhausted, the state ends.

skillTalents.name: Dark Voices Echo
skillTalents.description: Summons a Supersonic Oculus that taunts nearby opponents and attracts attacks. The Supersonic Oculus continuously rotates, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

passiveTalents.name: Nightshade's Synesthesia
passiveTalents.description: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Ororon gains 40 Nightsoul points. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. Additionally, when a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Ororon enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

passiveTalents.name: Spirit's Repose
passiveTalents.description: After other party members' Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, if Ororon is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, he will regain 3 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 1s. This effect can occur 3 times per Nightsoul's Blessing duration.

constellations.name: Vaporous Night-Walk
constellations.description: The Spirit Orb from Misty Night's Bindings can bounce 2 additional times. Additionally, after hitting an opponent with the Spirit Orb, its DMG is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: Hidden Spirits, Wine-Dark
constellations.description: After using the Elemental Burst Dark Voices Echo, Ororon gains 12% Electro DMG Bonus for 12s. For every additional opponent hit by the Supersonic Oculus, he gains an additional 12% Electro DMG Bonus, up to a maximum of 60%.

constellations.name: Roaming Fog-Tides
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dark Voices Echo by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: As the Deep Wind Howls
constellations.description: The Supersonic Oculus summoned by Dark Voices Echo rotates 25% faster.

constellations.name: Echoes of the Soul-Vessel
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Misty Night's Bindings by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Ode to Deep Springs
constellations.description: After triggering the effect from Passive Talent 'Nightshade's Synesthesia,' the current active character's ATK is increased by 10% for 9s. Max 3 stacks.
